records.context: A counting session is thousands of clicks and a proportion of them are wrong. The two ways of correcting a mistake are different actions: **undo** takes back the last thing you did, and **clicking a marker again** takes back a specific thing you did some time ago. Both are here, and clicking a marker removes it whatever class it was scored as — a counter who has to re-select the class before they can take a marker back will leave the wrong marker there.

records.context: That function keeps the caller's order but *drops* structured-data names it cannot resolve, so when everything resolves the answer is a zip and costs one scan. When some structured-data names miss, the returned list is a subsequence and no longer lines up, so the range is bisected: each half is asked separately until a half is either fully resolved (zip it) or a single structured-data name (resolve it or record the miss). records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Users often have 5–20 plates to segment, measure, or classify with the same settings. This module runs them one after another instead of one at a time from the Mask app. It lets users:
records.translation: 사용자는 같은 설정으로 분할, 측정 또는 분류할 플레이트를 5–20개씩 가지고 있는 경우가 많습니다. 이 모듈은 Mask 앱에서 하나씩 실행하는 대신 이들을 차례로 실행합니다. 사용자는 다음을 할 수 있습니다.

records.context: 1. Enqueue a plate as ``(app_key, settings)`` (or import a batch of plates from a CSV). 2. Execute the software job list in the background — one item at a time — and see per-item status update live. 3. Pause between items, or stop cold. 4. Have every completed item show up in the processing-session journal history like a normal invocation, so nothing about downstream tooling changes.
records.label: spacr.qt.plate_queue#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: 1. Enqueue a plate as ``(app_key, settings)`` (or import a batch of plates from a CSV). 2. Run the queue in the background — one item at a time — and see per-item status update live. 3. Pause between items, or stop cold. 4. Have every completed item show up in the run-journal history like a normal invocation, so nothing about downstream tooling changes.
records.translation: 1. 플레이트를 ``(app_key, settings)`` 형태로 대기열에 넣습니다(또는 CSV에서 여러 플레이트를 한 번에 가져옵니다). 2. 대기열을 백그라운드에서 — 한 번에 한 항목씩 — 실행하고 항목별 상태가 실시간으로 갱신되는 것을 봅니다. 3. 항목 사이에 일시 정지하거나 즉시 중지합니다. 4. 완료된 모든 항목이 일반 실행처럼 실행 기록 이력에 나타나므로, 후속 도구는 아무것도 바뀌지 않습니다.

What moved into :meth:`_refresh_job` is every filesystem call: ``find_scorecards`` walking the user's plate folders, one ``os.stat`` per card, and ``read_digest`` opening and parsing the CSVs. All of it is I/O on a path the user supplied.
records.translation: GUI 스레드에서 파일 시스템 호출이 하나도 실행되지 않도록 작업을 둘로 나눕니다. 여기에 남는 것은 위젯 상태 — ``src`` 필드와 그것이 무언가를 가리키는지 여부 — 이며, 비용이 들지 않습니다. :meth:`_refresh_job` 메서드로 옮겨진 것은 모든 파일 시스템 호출입니다. 사용자의 플레이트 폴더를 탐색하는 ``find_scorecards``, 카드마다 한 번의 ``os.stat``, 그리고 CSV 파일을 열어 파싱하는 ``read_digest``입니다. 이 모두가 사용자가 제공한 경로에 대한 I/O입니다.

records.context: Measured on one workstation: ``os.path.exists`` on a path under ``/nas_mnt`` — an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep — had not returned after twenty seconds, because the stat is what triggers the automount. This method used to do that work inline, and ``install_qc_banner`` used to call it inside ``MainWindow._build_screen``, so it was the whole interface frozen on every Measure open. It left no traceback, because a stalled event loop is not a crash; it was reported as "opening map barcodes crashes spacr", plus hover flicker and glimpses of other screens.

records.context: ``emit()`` executes on **whatever independent execution path logged the record** — Python's logging module calls handlers inline. A ConsolePanel answers ``append_stdout`` by *constructing QWidgets* (a topic bar and a text block), and Qt forbids building a QWidget anywhere but the main GUI execution path. Calling the panel straight from ``emit()`` therefore built widgets on a background execution unit; Qt printed ``QObject::setParent: Cannot set parent, new parent is in a different thread`` and then took the process down. It was reproducible from :meth:`spacr.qt.hf_download._HFDownloadWorker.run`, whose exception path logs a warning from inside the download independent execution path.

records.source: ``emit()`` runs on **whatever thread logged the record** — Python's logging module calls handlers inline. A ConsolePanel answers ``append_stdout`` by *constructing QWidgets* (a topic bar and a text block), and Qt forbids building a QWidget anywhere but the GUI thread. Calling the panel straight from ``emit()`` therefore built widgets on a worker thread; Qt printed ``QObject::setParent: Cannot set parent, new parent is in a different thread`` and then took the process down. It was reproducible from :meth:`spacr.qt.hf_download._HFDownloadWorker.run`, whose exception path logs a warning from inside the download thread.
records.translation: ``emit()`` 메서드는 **레코드를 기록한 스레드가 무엇이든 그 스레드에서** 실행됩니다 — Python의 logging 모듈은 핸들러를 인라인으로 호출합니다. ConsolePanel은 ``append_stdout`` 호출에 대해 *QWidgets를 생성*하며(주제 표시줄과 텍스트 블록), Qt는 GUI 스레드 이외의 곳에서 QWidget을 만드는 것을 금지합니다. 따라서 ``emit()`` 메서드에서 패널을 직접 호출하면 작업자 스레드에서 위젯이 만들어졌고, Qt는 ``QObject::setParent: Cannot set parent, new parent is in a different thread`` 메시지를 출력한 뒤 프로세스를 종료시켰습니다. 이 문제는 :meth:`spacr.qt.hf_download._HFDownloadWorker.run` 메서드에서 재현할 수 있었는데, 그 예외 경로가 다운로드 스레드 안에서 경고를 기록하기 때문입니다.

records.context: Every generated GIF draws its scene inside the same rounded "well" — the 336-pixel frame that :func:`tools.generate_setting_animations._well` paints at (12, 12)-(348, 348) on a 360-pixel black square. The *scene* inside it is usually far smaller than the microplate sample position. Measured across all 94 packaged animations, the median content covers only 63.9 % of the square, 72 of them are below 70 %, and the smallest (``nucleus_diameter``) covers 22.8 %. At tooltip size that leaves a few dozen pixels of actual illustration floating in black.

records.source: Every generated GIF draws its scene inside the same rounded "well" — the 336-pixel frame that :func:`tools.generate_setting_animations._well` paints at (12, 12)-(348, 348) on a 360-pixel black square. The *scene* inside it is usually far smaller than the well. Measured across all 94 packaged animations, the median content covers only 63.9 % of the square, 72 of them are below 70 %, and the smallest (``nucleus_diameter``) covers 22.8 %. At tooltip size that leaves a few dozen pixels of actual illustration floating in black.
records.translation: 생성된 모든 GIF는 같은 둥근 "well"(테두리 틀) 안에 장면을 그립니다 — :func:`tools.generate_setting_animations._well` 함수가 360픽셀 검은 정사각형 위 (12, 12)-(348, 348) 위치에 그리는 336픽셀 프레임입니다. 그 안의 *장면*은 보통 이 틀보다 훨씬 작습니다. 패키지에 포함된 94개 애니메이션 전체를 측정하면 내용이 차지하는 비율의 중앙값은 정사각형의 63.9 %에 불과하고, 그중 72개는 70 % 미만이며, 가장 작은 것(``nucleus_diameter``)은 22.8 %입니다. 툴팁 크기에서는 실제 그림이 수십 픽셀 정도만 검은 바탕 위에 떠 있게 됩니다.

records.context: So the frames are not shown as generated. Each animation's real content bounds are measured once — the union, across every frame, of everything that is neither background nor well chrome — and the frames are then cropped and rescaled so the content covers a fixed :data:`TARGET_FILL` share of the square. Animations whose content already overflows that share (the ``remove_border_objects`` scenes reach 91.9 %) are scaled *down* to the same target, so every animation in the app is presented at one consistent size.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.animation_zoom#2

records.source: So the frames are not shown as generated. Each animation's real content bounds are measured once — the union, across every frame, of everything that is neither background nor well chrome — and the frames are then cropped and rescaled so the content covers a fixed :data:`TARGET_FILL` share of the square. Animations whose content already overflows that share (the ``remove_border_objects`` scenes reach 91.9 %) are scaled *down* to the same target, so every animation in the app is presented at one consistent size.
records.translation: 그래서 프레임을 생성된 그대로 보여 주지 않습니다. 각 애니메이션의 실제 내용 경계를 한 번 측정하고 — 모든 프레임에 걸쳐 배경도 틀 장식도 아닌 모든 것의 합집합 — 내용이 정사각형의 고정된 :data:`TARGET_FILL` 비율을 차지하도록 프레임을 자르고 크기를 조정합니다. 내용이 이미 그 비율을 넘는 애니메이션(``remove_border_objects`` 장면은 91.9 %에 이름)은 같은 목표로 *축소*되므로, 앱의 모든 애니메이션이 하나의 일관된 크기로 표시됩니다.

records.context: The measurement decodes and scans every frame, which is far too expensive to repeat on an animation tick — :func:`zoomed_animation` is therefore cached on ``(file, size, target)`` and hands back finished, display-sized frames.

records.source: **Memoised per frame object.** The classification runs ``Series.nunique()`` over every column, which on a 200 000-row x 48-column measurement table costs 230 ms. Loading one table used to pay that *four* times inside a single ``set_frame`` — this function, plus :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.graph_spec.column_kinds`, plus ``GraphSpec.kinds_for``, plus ``plottable_columns``, each re-deriving the same answer from the same object — 0.9 s of the ~1.9 s the GUI thread spent delivering a freshly loaded frame.
records.translation: **프레임 객체별로 메모이즈됩니다.** 분류는 모든 열에 대해 ``Series.nunique()``를 실행하며, 200 000행 x 48열 측정 테이블에서는 230 ms가 걸립니다. 예전에는 테이블 하나를 불러올 때 ``set_frame`` 호출 한 번 안에서 이 비용을 *네 번* 치렀습니다 — 이 함수, :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.graph_spec.column_kinds` 함수, ``GraphSpec.kinds_for``, ``plottable_columns``가 각각 같은 객체에서 같은 답을 다시 도출했고 — 새로 불러온 프레임을 전달하는 데 GUI 스레드가 쓴 약 1.9 s 중 0.9 s가 여기에 들었습니다.

The shape is checked too, since a frame can be mutated in place.

The shape is checked too, since a frame can be mutated in place.
records.translation: 키는 프레임의 내용이 아니라 *동일성*입니다. 부분 집합은 행이 더 적어 실제로 다르게 분류될 수 있으므로, 필터링된 프레임에 대해 다시 도출하는 것은 낭비가 아니라 올바른 동작입니다. records.translation: 설계 규칙

records.context: **It validates while you type, not when you commit.** The expression is parsed on every keystroke (a parse of a forty-character string is microseconds), so the error message for ``area / perimter`` appears next to the typo rather than after an Add that appears to do nothing. The Add button is disabled until the formula parses *and* resolves against the loaded table.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.formula_editor#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **It validates while you type, not when you commit.** The expression is parsed on every keystroke (a parse of a forty-character string is microseconds), so the error message for ``area / perimter`` appears next to the typo rather than after an Add that appears to do nothing. The Add button is disabled until the formula parses *and* resolves against the loaded table.
records.translation: **확정할 때가 아니라 입력하는 동안 검증합니다.** 식은 키 입력마다 파싱되므로(사십 글자 문자열의 파싱은 마이크로초 단위), ``area / perimter``에 대한 오류 메시지는 아무 일도 하지 않는 것처럼 보이는 Add 다음이 아니라 오타 바로 옆에 나타납니다. Add 버튼은 수식이 파싱되고 *또한* 불러온 테이블에 대해 확인될 때까지 비활성화됩니다.

records.context: **It shows the values, not just the syntax.** A formula can be perfectly valid and produce a column that is 90% infinities, which no amount of syntax checking catches. The preview evaluates the expression over the head of the table and prints :attr:`~spacr.qt.widgets.formula.ColumnResult.notice` — "3 of 4 rows have a finite value · 1 became NaN or infinite in the calculation" — so a bad ratio column is noticed before it reaches a chart.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.formula_editor#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **It shows the values, not just the syntax.** A formula can be perfectly valid and produce a column that is 90% infinities, which no amount of syntax checking catches. The preview evaluates the expression over the head of the table and prints :attr:`~spacr.qt.widgets.formula.ColumnResult.notice` — "3 of 4 rows have a finite value · 1 became NaN or infinite in the calculation" — so a bad ratio column is noticed before it reaches a chart.
records.translation: **구문만이 아니라 값을 보여 줍니다.** 수식이 완벽하게 유효하더라도 90%가 무한대인 열을 만들 수 있으며, 구문 검사로는 이를 잡을 수 없습니다. 미리 보기는 테이블의 앞부분에 대해 식을 평가하고 :attr:`~spacr.qt.widgets.formula.ColumnResult.notice` 값을 출력하므로 — "4개 행 중 3개 행에 유한한 값이 있음 · 1개 행은 계산 중 NaN 또는 무한대가 됨" — 잘못된 비율 열을 차트에 이르기 전에 알아챌 수 있습니다.

records.context: **It hands back a frame, not a mutation.** :meth:`FormulaPanel.computed_frame` returns the loaded table *plus* the computed columns, a copy every time. The loaded frame is never grown, so removing a formula removes its column, and two application views showing the same table do not accumulate each other's columns.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.formula_editor#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **It hands back a frame, not a mutation.** :meth:`FormulaPanel.computed_frame` returns the loaded table *plus* the computed columns, a copy every time. The loaded frame is never grown, so removing a formula removes its column, and two screens showing the same table do not accumulate each other's columns.
records.translation: **변경이 아니라 프레임을 돌려줍니다.** :meth:`FormulaPanel.computed_frame` 메서드는 불러온 테이블에 계산된 열을 *더한* 것을 매번 사본으로 반환합니다. 불러온 프레임은 절대 늘어나지 않으므로, 수식을 제거하면 그 열도 제거되고, 같은 테이블을 보여 주는 두 화면이 서로의 열을 누적하지 않습니다.

Checkpoints are large -- the Toxoplasma models are 1.2 GB each -- and on a shared workstation or a laptop with a small root volume the default is often the wrong disk. A lab that keeps models on a NAS wants them there once, not once per user. So the folder is on application view, remembered between openings, and shown before anything is fetched rather than discovered afterwards in a full-disk error.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.model_zoo_picker#2

records.context: :class:`TrellisCanvas` **subclasses** :class:`spacr.qt.widgets.graph_builder.GraphCanvas` rather than reimplementing it. The mark drawing, the fixed categorical hue order, the density raster, the selection ring, the legend and the brush are one implementation, and a second one would be a second set of rules to keep in step with the first — the mistake :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.pivot_builder` avoids by not drawing anything at all.

The mark drawing, the fixed categorical hue order, the density raster, the selection ring, the legend and the brush are one implementation, and a second one would be a second set of rules to keep in step with the first — the mistake :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.pivot_builder` avoids by not drawing anything at all.
records.translation: :class:`TrellisCanvas` 클래스는 :class:`spacr.qt.widgets.graph_builder.GraphCanvas` 클래스를 다시 구현하지 않고 **상속**합니다. 표식 그리기, 고정된 범주 색조 순서, 밀도 래스터, 선택 링, 범례, 브러시는 하나의 구현이며, 두 번째 구현을 두면 첫 번째와 맞춰 관리해야 할 규칙이 하나 더 생깁니다 — :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.pivot_builder` 모듈은 아무것도 그리지 않음으로써 이 실수를 피합니다.

records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_view#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **the layout** comes from :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_spec.trellis`, which knows about wrapping and about blank slots, rather than from ``facet_grid`` directly;
records.translation: **레이아웃**은 줄 바꿈과 빈 칸을 아는 :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_spec.trellis` 함수에서 오며, ``facet_grid``에서 직접 오지 않습니다.

records.context: **the scales are set per panel from that panel's own group**. Every panel's limits are written explicitly rather than left to matplotlib's ``sharex``: sharing makes panels agree with *each other*, but on whatever the first one autoscaled to, which is not necessarily wide enough for the rest. Under :data:`~spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_spec.SCALE_SHARED` — the default — every panel is handed the identical tuple, which is a property a test can assert and an eye can trust.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_view#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **the scales are set per panel from that panel's own group**. Every panel's limits are written explicitly rather than left to matplotlib's ``sharex``: sharing makes panels agree with *each other*, but on whatever the first one autoscaled to, which is not necessarily wide enough for the rest. Under :data:`~spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_spec.SCALE_SHARED` — the default — every panel is handed the identical tuple, which is a property a test can assert and an eye can trust.
records.translation: **배율은 패널마다 그 패널 자체의 그룹으로부터 설정됩니다**. 모든 패널의 범위는 matplotlib의 ``sharex``에 맡기지 않고 명시적으로 기록됩니다. 공유는 패널들이 *서로* 일치하게 만들지만, 첫 패널이 자동 배율로 정한 범위를 기준으로 하며 그 범위가 나머지 패널에 충분히 넓다는 보장은 없습니다. 기본값인 :data:`~spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_spec.SCALE_SHARED` 모드에서는 모든 패널이 똑같은 튜플을 받으며, 이는 테스트가 검증할 수 있고 눈으로 믿을 수 있는 속성입니다.
